name: marketlink
description: MarketLink – farmers market pre-order platform (MERN: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
